snippet.title: Baldur's Gate, Neverwinter Nights, Planescape: Torment & Icewind Dale - Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The Enhanced Editions of the classic Dungeons & Dragons inspired tales: Baldur’s Gate, Neverwinter Nights, Icewind Dale, and Planescape: Torment are coming to the Nintendo Switch for the first time, this Fall 2019! Remastered, updated, and tailored for a natural gameplay experience, these special boxed editions are perfect for experiencing these critically acclaimed and well-loved RPGs in a brand-new way! With native support for Switch in all gameplay modes, you’ll be able to take the adventure with you wherever you go.

Pre-order these iconic titles for Nintendo Switch NOW! http://bit.ly/2Wj9S9d
